label: SYNTHETIC BENCHMARK — not observed data
purpose: Numerical performance benchmark of the pure economic.crude_exposure L1/L2 path (architecture §20.3: 'The four-country numerical benchmark uses a complete labelled test fixture; the initial live scenario uses the three verified countries.'). Only consumed by tests/performance/test_perf_simulation.py and scripts/measure_performance.py.
usage_restrictions: Never ingest, publish, cite or display these values as evidence, beliefs or source reports.
Values are rounded synthetic magnitudes chosen to be plausible in order of magnitude only; they are not copied from, and must not be compared with, any provider dataset.
In particular the DZA crude flows are synthetic: the live Comtrade query for DZA 2023 returned no rows and is stored as typed Missing.

units.M: current USD, crude (HS 2709) import border value from World, one calendar year (synthetic)
units.X: current USD, crude (HS 2709) export border value to World, one calendar year (synthetic)
units.G: current USD, nominal GDP, one calendar year (synthetic)
